method.note: Judged from cached vision readings only. Hard-rejected any image whose cached caption or subjects mention a face, portrait, woman, girl, person, eyes, model, singer, dancer or figure, and any image with non-empty textInImage.

WARNING_ASPECT: EVERY lexicon image is 1152x832 LANDSCAPE (scripts/lexicon/art.mjs line 41: const W = 1152, H = 832). object-cover into 1080x1920 scales 832->1920 (2.31x), giving 2659px of width against a 1080px frame: 59% of every image's width is thrown away. That is the SAME bug as the 17 existing scenes. Do NOT full-bleed these. crop:'safe' = full-field texture/abstract, survives a hard centre crop. crop:'letterbox' = composed scene, must be shown as a 1080-wide band (1080x780) inside the portrait frame, or blur-extended, or slow-panned; never object-cover.

picks.line: They said "she's so cute" — mmm, keep talking
picks.why: Opens the window in her room, not on her face: a chilled amber cocktail in a dim bar is the Osaka-gold night in one object, and it lets the cocky opening line land on a look-but-don't-touch prop.

vision.caption: A chilled amber cocktail with geometric ice cubes glows warmly in a dimly lit bar setting.
vision.style: photorealistic with cinematic lighting

picks.line: I'm the trap and the bait, watch how I'm walking
picks.why: The sense gloss is literally 'Sweet entrapment' — a molten-gold cityscape glowing like liquid honey is the trap-and-bait line rendered as pure environment, and it is a full-field texture so it survives any crop.

vision.caption: A shattered cityscape bathed in molten gold, where fire and ruin glow like liquid honey.
vision.style: Hyperrealistic digital painting with dramatic lighting

picks.line: I'm the trap and the bait, watch how I'm walking
picks.why: Boots stepping through neon rain puddles — the only thing in frame is the walk itself, no face, so it illustrates 'watch how I'm walking' without competing with the Kizuna portrait layer.

vision.caption: A lone figure's boots step through neon-drenched rain puddles reflecting fractured city lights, embodying the song's desperate march toward oblivion.
vision.style: Cyberpunk realism with cinematic lighting and shallow depth of field

picks.line: Any key, any tongue, any tempo — slow it down, speed it up
picks.why: A molten sunburst pouring liquid gold in 'slow-motion rays' is the tempo-drop made visual, and it is the single most on-palette gold field in the whole lexicon.

vision.caption: A molten sunburst floods the horizon with liquid gold, casting slow-motion rays across a hazy sky.
vision.style: abstract impressionism with soft gradients

picks.line: Any key, any tongue, any tempo — slow it down, speed it up
picks.why: Long-exposure car light-trails across a wet highway is the 'speed it up' half of the same bar; cutting it hard against the slow gold sunburst gives the line its own tempo flip.

vision.caption: A blurred cityscape at night where streaks of light from speeding cars blur into glowing trails across a wet highway.
vision.style: Long exposure photography with motion blur and bokeh lighting effects

picks.line: Either way I'm never breaking a sweat, what
picks.why: Gold droplets falling in a warm blur — macro, abstract, no body — says 'sweat' as luxury rather than effort, which is exactly her brag.

vision.caption: A golden cascade of shimmering droplets falls in a blurred, warm glow.
vision.style: macro photography with bokeh effect

picks.line: Welcome to the reverl— (giggle) ...LevelReady, baby~
picks.why: A vintage mic alone on a dim stage in warm gold light is the label-drop shot: it says 'welcome to the room' and it is the one moment the reel should look like a venue, not a street.

vision.caption: A vintage microphone stands alone on a dimly lit stage, bathed in warm golden light with blurred bokeh orbs in the background.
vision.style: Moody cinematic photography with shallow depth of field

picks.line: Practiced that aaaall week for you. Crazy, ne?
picks.why: Word she actually sings; a blazing molten-gold sunburst against a void is the giggle turning into a flex, and the void background means the lyric type will read cleanly over it.

vision.caption: A blazing sunburst of molten gold and fiery orange radiates intense energy against a void.
vision.style: digital painting with textured brushstrokes

picks.line: Egi on the throne and xsytrance in the bloodline
picks.why: Literal sung word, wordMatch 0.95: a solitary ornate golden throne in a dim chiaroscuro chamber — the empty throne is better than any occupied one because the song is naming the man, not showing him.

vision.caption: A solitary, ornate golden throne sits in a dimly lit chamber, its intricate carvings casting long shadows on the wooden floor.
vision.style: dramatic chiaroscuro with baroque details

picks.emotion: Precious transformation and value found in self
picks.line: Egi on the throne and xsytrance in the bloodline
picks.why: Liquid gold cascading in molten streams over a midnight cityscape is 'bloodline' as a flowing line of gold — lineage without a single human body in frame.

vision.caption: Liquid gold cascades in molten streams, reflecting starlight across a midnight cityscape.
vision.style: Digital painting with fluid dynamics and luminous textures

picks.line: Same man, three names — I only need the one, shine~
picks.why: A gilded crown under a hard spotlight against black is the 'I only need the one' image: one object, one light, gold leaf on void, straight down the OSAKA GOLD-LEAF NIGHT palette.

vision.caption: A gilded crown with intricate gold filigree and gemstones rests on a wooden surface, illuminated by a bright spotlight against a dark backdrop.
vision.style: Photorealistic still life with cinematic lighting

picks.line: Same man, three names — I only need the one, shine~
picks.why: Highest wordMatch in the shortlist (0.98): a single radiant golden star on black is the word 'shine' with nothing else in the frame, perfect for the held tail of the line.

vision.caption: A radiant golden star glows intensely against a dark backdrop, casting sharp shadows on a reflective surface.
vision.style: digital realism with cinematic lighting

picks.line: Ne, ne... one more secret before the lights come up...
picks.why: Literal sung word: a luminous golden vortex in a dark sky hiding a light at its core — a secret that has not opened yet, sitting right where the bridge strips down to strings.

vision.caption: A luminous golden vortex swirls through a dark sky, revealing a hidden light at its core.
vision.style: digital painting with textured brushstrokes

picks.line: The doors swung open, lights hit and we felt it.
picks.why: A single door ajar in pitch darkness spilling warm amber light is the bridge's key image done exactly as sung, and the pitch-black surround is free letterbox.

vision.caption: A solitary door stands ajar in pitch darkness, spilling warm amber light onto an empty floor.
vision.style: minimalist surrealism

picks.line: The doors swung open, lights hit and we felt it.
picks.why: A radiant burst of golden light exploding outward across a dark canvas is 'lights hit' as an event rather than a place — the impact frame of the whole bridge.

vision.caption: A radiant burst of golden light explodes outward, scattering glowing orbs like captured sunbeams across a dark canvas.
vision.style: Impressionistic abstract with bokeh effect

picks.line: But I didn't walk in alone, ne?
picks.why: A rain-slicked lantern alley between towering old buildings reads as Dotonbori back-street; warm lanterns down both sides say she walked in with company without showing a soul.

vision.caption: A rain-slicked alleyway at night glows with warm lantern light reflecting off wet cobblestones beneath towering, ancient buildings.
vision.style: Digital painting with atmospheric perspective and soft lighting

picks.line: (giggle) ...the house was already warm when I got here~
picks.why: The word is literally 'home' and the sense emotion is 'Flirtatious Confidence': a labyrinth of weathered wooden buildings bathed in warm lantern light is 'the house was already warm', and it cuts as a continuation of the previous alley.

vision.caption: A labyrinthine steampunk alleyway bathed in warm lantern light, where weathered wooden buildings cling together like ancient bones.
vision.style: Steampunk meets traditional Chinese architecture with painterly textures

picks.line: Hajimemashite, ne?
picks.why: Molten gold spilling from a fractured glass cup, sense 'Wealth & Confidence' — the biggest, most expensive-looking gold in the library, saved for the first line of the final chorus.

vision.caption: A molten golden liquid spills from a fractured glass cup, glowing with inner light against a backdrop of shattered reflections.
vision.style: Hyperrealistic digital art with liquid light effects

picks.line: Remember the face, remember the sound!
picks.why: 'Remember the sound' cannot be a face, so it becomes one: a bass guitar neck glowing under stage light with the strings still vibrating, wordMatch 0.95, warm brown-gold and no green in the palette.

vision.caption: A weathered bass guitar's neck glows under stage lights, strings vibrating with unseen music.
vision.style: cinematic close-up with bokeh lighting

picks.line: Hajimemashite, ne? (su-ki su-ki~)
picks.why: A sea of warm golden orbs over a reflective surface — quality 0.95 — is the 'su-ki su-ki' sugar moment: soft, adoring, and abstract enough to sit under big type.

vision.caption: A sea of warm golden orbs floats above a reflective surface, glowing softly in the dark.
vision.style: Bokeh photography, abstract realism

picks.line: Kizuna Sato —
picks.why: A rain-slicked Tokyo street at midnight with gold in the palette (#d4af37), sense emotion 'Defiant' — the city itself under her name, wide and environmental, the antidote to the selfie problem.

vision.caption: A rain-slicked Tokyo street at midnight glows with blurred neon lights reflecting on wet asphalt, capturing the city's silent sorrow.
vision.style: Moody cinematic realism with shallow depth of field

picks.line: LevelReady 'til the wheels fall off, aishiteru~
picks.why: Gold chains hanging in a dim room, links catching light 'like liquid amber' — this is the LevelReady chain from the chorus, shot as jewellery instead of as a necklace on a neck.

vision.caption: Golden chains hang suspended in a dimly lit room, their links catching light like liquid amber.
vision.style: photorealistic with shallow depth of field

picks.line: (BELTED) And now... you know... my naaaame~
picks.why: Quality 0.95 / wordMatch 0.98: a searing diagonal blaze of molten gold consuming the whole frame — the only image in the shortlist big enough to sit under the belt.

vision.caption: A searing diagonal blaze of molten gold and amber fire consumes the frame with intense, swirling heat.
vision.style: Digital painting with fluid, dynamic brushstrokes

picks.line: (BELTED) And now... you know... my naaaame~
picks.why: A tunnel of molten gold leading toward a radiant sun, reflecting on wet tracks — the exit frame: the held note resolving into pure gold light as the window ends.

vision.caption: A tunnel of molten gold leads toward a radiant sun, reflecting on wet tracks like liquid light.
vision.style: Impressionistic digital painting with textured brushstrokes
